title: Auto OCO Brackets
content:
What are the Auto-OCO Bracket Orders?
Built for precision, flexibility, and control, these order-based brackets allow you to set take-profit (TP) and stop-loss (SL) orders tailored to each individual trade entry — giving you the power to scale in, scale out, and manage risk per strategy, per account. The Auto OCO brackets will allow your TP/SL orders to be applied per each individual order entry into the market.
What is the difference between Position Brackets and Auto-OCO Bracket Orders?
Feature Overview
Position Brackets (Position-Bsed)
Auto OCO Brackets (Order-Based)
Ease of Use
Simple, easy to use by default
Designed for advanced control and flexibility
Scaling In Behavior
Auto-aggregates TP/SL orders to average entry price when scaling in
TP/SL are linked to the individual entry order price - no forced averaging
Scaling Out Behavior
Automatically cancels matching portion of TP/SL
Supports multiple TP/SL targets at different price levels
Stop Order Type
All Stop Loss orders will be Stop Market order types
Trailing Stop, Auto Break-even, and Stop Limit orders Coming Soon!
Saved Bracket Strategies
1 Setup per account
Save and name multiple bracket strategies
Brackets on Working Limits / Stop Orders
Cannot view the TP/SL orders on working Limit/Stop orders until executed
Visual overlay of suspended TP/SL before execution
Risk of Leftover Orders
None due to auto-cancel logic
Must manage bracket orders manually
Best for
Traders who are looking to set it and forget it - less hands on attention and management of working orders.
Scalpers and/or traders who want multiple TP/SL orders per individual entry orders and are actively monitoring their working orders.
How to Enable Auto-OCO Brackets
The Bracket type can be switched from the Settings and/or each order entry component (i.e., Chart, Order Card, DOM)
Go to: Settings -> Risk Settings
Switch to Auto OCO Brackets
Setup and Save Auto OCO Bracket Setup
You must be completely flat before switching bracket types (e.g., Position Brackets vs. Auto OCOs)
Customizing Your Auto OCO Brackets
Once enabled, the Order Ticket will update with new bracket setup tools:
Set TP/SL in ticks or $
Drag & drop TP/SL directly on working Limit and Stop orders
View TP/SL overlay on DOM before placing the order

How to Enable Auto-OCO Brackets

The Bracket type can be switched from the Settings and/or each order entry component (i.e., Chart, Order Card, DOM)

  1. Go to: Settings -> Risk Settings

  2. Switch to Auto OCO Brackets

  3. Setup and Save Auto OCO Bracket Setup

You must be completely flat before switching bracket types (e.g., Position Brackets vs. Auto OCOs)

Customizing Your Auto OCO Brackets

Once enabled, the Order Ticket will update with new bracket setup tools:

  • Set TP/SL in ticks or $

  • Drag & drop TP/SL directly on working Limit and Stop orders

  • View TP/SL overlay on DOM before placing the order
